definitions.explanation: The elementary school student government, composed of elected representatives from upper grades who run assemblies and student-led activities. The middle/high school counterpart is the {生徒会|せいとかい}.

examples.japanese: {児童会|じどうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
{児童会|じどうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I was elected president of the student council.

examples.japanese: {児童会|じどうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦リーダーシップ→リーダーシップ：09596_riidaashippu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I learned leadership through student council activities.

notes:
⟦{児童|じどう}→児童：03340_jidou⟧ (children, used officially for elementary-school pupils) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (association). Specifically the elementary-school student council; junior high and high school have a ⟦{生徒会|せいとかい}→生徒会：05378_seitokai⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {児童会|じどうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧: student council president
- {児童会|じどうかい}⟦{役員|やくいん}→役員：11329_yakuin⟧: student council officer
- {児童会|じどうかい}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: student council activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生徒会|せいとかい}→生徒会：05378_seitokai⟧: student council (junior high / high school)
- ⟦{学生会|がくせいかい}→学生会：28837_gakuseikai⟧: student government (university)
- PTA: parent-teacher association — for parents, not students
